decisions.reason: Launched only in 2023 with prospects still highly uncertain, the enclosed laser marking workstation is a cheap option to hold within an existing marking portfolio, though its mere mention on the website points to a lower commitment than the other products.

The thermal inkjet printer has its own product page, signalling active commitment, and one year of results is too little to resolve uncertainty about its value, so keeping this low-cost option open is warranted.

The piezo inkjet printer is prominently presented and complements the thermal variant, and with its value still uncertain and holding costs modest for a large machinery firm, abandoning it this early would forgo option value.
